title: Baby Toddler fruit and vegetables, with yogurt

content.title: About
content.content: Fruit and vegetable puree with yogurt is designed for babies and toddlers. It contains carefully selected fruits, vegetables and natural yogurt, providing a balanced mix of vitamins, minerals and probiotics.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The combination of fruit, vegetable and yogurt helps develop taste preferences in young children.
Yogurt in the product contains live cultures beneficial for gut microbiota.
All ingredients undergo gentle heat treatment that preserves most vitamins.
The product contains no added sugar, artificial colors or flavors.
Packaging is made from safe, reusable material.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Fruits and yogurt provide B1, B2 and B6 vitamins, essential for energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Immune support
items.content: Vitamin C from fruits and probiotics from yogurt help strengthen the immune system.

items.title: Digestive health
items.content: Probiotics in yogurt promote a healthy gut flora, improving digestion.

items.title: Calcium source
items.content: Yogurt supplies calcium needed for bone and teeth development in children.

items.title: Vision development
items.content: Beta‑carotene from vegetables converts to vitamin A, important for eyesight.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Children with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy should avoid the product.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Although no added sugar is present, natural fruit sugars may need to be limited for children at risk of cavities.

items.title: Age restrictions
items.content: The product is recommended for children from 6 months old. Younger infants should be introduced only after consulting a pediatrician.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the puree as a standalone snack or mix into cereals, cottage cheese, or baby desserts. Before serving, gently warm to room temperature if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days. Do not freeze.
